INFRA-OSM-GEV.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors (via the gods-eye-view bundled snapshot)

notes: Original OSM extraction date and query were not recorded by the upstream snapshot.
Dams were extracted by upstream from OpenInfraMap/PostGIS layers (waterway=dam, man_made=dam, building=dam).
Upstream removed contact tags (email, phone, fax) before release.

INFRA-OSM-GEV.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Dams also credit Open Infrastructure Map.
INFRA-OSM-GEV.spatialSupport: OSM building footprint polygon or point; representative point = outer-ring vertex average
limitations: Coverage is whatever OSM volunteers mapped; absence of a facility is not evidence it does not exist.
operator and owner are free-text OSM tags and may be stale, abbreviated or a brand rather than the legal entity.
Power values are tagged capacity ratings (kW), not measured consumption or generation.
No electricity or water consumption is reported by this source.

INFRA-GPPD.name: Global Power Plant Database
INFRA-GPPD.attribution: Global Energy Observatory, Google, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Enipedia, World Resources Institute. Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0 (2021). Published on Resource Watch and Google Earth Engine.
limitations: Last updated June 2021 and no longer maintained: newer plants are missing and some listed plants may have closed.
Covers ~35,000 plants; small distributed generation (rooftop solar, small diesel) is largely absent.
Capacity is nameplate (MW), not available or dispatched output.
Generation figures are annual totals; 'estimated' values come from WRI's model, not metered data.
Owner is as reported by the source database and may be out of date.

INFRA-OURAIRPORTS.name: OurAirports
INFRA-OURAIRPORTS.product: OurAirports airports.csv, large and medium airports only
limitations: Community-maintained; size class (large/medium) is OurAirports' own classification, not traffic data.
Small airfields, heliports, seaplane bases and closed airports are left out.
No passenger, cargo or runway capacity figures are included.

INFRA-NE-PORTS.name: Natural Earth ports
INFRA-NE-PORTS.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
INFRA-NE-PORTS.spatialSupport: Port point at cartographic scale (may be offset from the actual terminals)
limitations: A cartographic selection of ~1,000 notable ports, not a complete register of harbours or terminals.
'Major port' means a higher Natural Earth display rank, not measured throughput.
No cargo, berth, draught or operator information.

INFRA-GRID-OSM.name: OSM high-voltage grid (prepared regions)
INFRA-GRID-OSM.product: OSM power=line/cable and power=substation features at or above 66 kV
INFRA-GRID-OSM.spatialSupport: OSM way geometry (simplified ~30 m for display) or substation centre
limitations: Prepared for the project regions only (arizona, uk); elsewhere use 'Load OSM power here' on a location.
Only features tagged with a voltage of 66 kV or more; distribution lines and untagged substations are left out.
Volunteer-mapped: routes and voltages may be incomplete or out of date.
Lines show mapped routes, not thermal capacity, spare capacity or connection headroom.
